Citing a Binance customer email, Cryptoast reported that accounts still holding assets will incur a monthly management fee of 0.025%, with a minimum charge of 10 USDC, starting November 29. Bitcoin Core Developer Proposes Collateral and Auction Mechanisms to Deter Quantum Theft

Bitcoin Core developer Cory Fields has outlined three proposed mechanisms, Quantum Landmines, Staked Auction, and Sats Auction, to deter future quantum-enabled Bitcoin theft. Under the proposed framework, spending legacy BTC after quantum attacks become feasible would require equivalent BTC collateral. Quantum Landmines would allow owners who established cryptographic proofs in advance to protect their funds and claim an attacker's collateral.

Gnosis Pay Confirms Customer Data Exposure Following Unauthorized System Access

Crypto payment card provider Gnosis Pay disclosed that unauthorized access to its legacy B2C card system was detected on November 3, exposing some customer information. The company began containment within two hours, replaced compromised credentials, and addressed the vulnerability. Gnosis Pay said customer funds and its enterprise white-label card platform were unaffected. US October Nonfarm Payrolls Rise by 165K, Beating 65K Forecast

U.S. nonfarm payrolls rose by 165,000 in October, beating expectations of 65,000, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics. September's figure was revised up from 29,000 to 60,000. The unemployment rate fell to 4.1%, below the 4.2% forecast and previous reading. Average hourly earnings increased 0.4% month-over-month and 3.1% year-over-year, both above expectations of 0.3% and 2.9%, respectively. — link

Some funds belonged to at least 10 financial crime victims.
